title: Phone-class estimates
intro: The phone-class bench (P1, G-phone) on `world-np-lite.tgd`: open, the first query of each kind, search a keystroke at a time and the point queries, each the minimum of several rounds here and multiplied by 6.5 (this machine's core over a low-end phone's), and the heap counted by allocator; the gate fails when an estimate is over its target. A point query is `reverse_in_country` (10 nearest), `admin_at`, `tz_at` and `elevation_at`; the page cache is warm, as on a relaunch.
